$comment: Vigila operational failure boundaries. Expected domain refusals remain typed application outcomes and are not Aegis faults.

boundaries.name: Limen engine message dispatch
boundaries.$comment: The JSON message parser and authority-side Limen dispatcher are captured by Aegis. Programming defects still fail loudly under Aegis semantics.

boundaries.name: Echelon followup.create provider boundary
boundaries.$comment: Integration.create captures unexpected ledger exceptions with Aegis and maps typed ledger failures (VIG-AGT-050 codes such as RepositoryUnavailable, RateLimited, StorageCorrupt, PersistenceFailed) to VIGILA.INTEGRATION.<CODE> faults. Validation refusals, unsupported contract versions and operation-id conflicts are typed outcomes, not faults. See ADR-0004.

boundaries.name: Browser HTTP and storage effects
boundaries.$comment: Execution occurs browser-side. Observed HTTP/storage outcomes cross the Limen protocol as explicit typed outcomes; this declaration does not pretend the .NET Aegis runtime guards JavaScript fetch/localStorage.

boundaries.name: Future direct GitHub host
boundaries.$comment: The host currently defines typed failure vocabulary but performs no direct GitHub call. A real host call must add Aegis capture and stable code mapping before this boundary can be marked guarded.

persistence.fallbackBehaviour: Aegis sink failures are contained by the configured fallback; Vigila does not treat diagnostic persistence as business success.
persistence.retentionPolicy: No durable Aegis sink is configured in the current browser application baseline.
